verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a developer CLI like mise, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out setting. Related security controls such as MISE_SAFE, minimum release age and sandboxing do not address usage tracking and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
